title: Energy-grid-like structures beneath the pyramids
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Energy-grid-like structures beneath the pyramids, about ancient; scans in 2025 at Egypt (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's real evidence that there's structures under the pyramids that might go as deep as 2 km
And there is 100% something underneath the pyramids in that shape, the coils, the columns.
tellings.difference: Names Filippo Biondi and Christopher Dunn and describes the structures as coiled columns. It does not give the 2 km depth.
tellings.link_reason: These are the same 2025 scans of structures under the Giza pyramids that telling 5 describes, now credited to Biondi's SAR work.

as_told.title: Biondi's SAR scans show coiled columns under the pyramids
